scope.vision_tower: vision.* and aligner.* out of scope (32 layers / 1024 hidden ViT + 2-layer projector)
scope.lane_note: engram conditional-memory tables are host-resident (196B params, RDMA prefetch per tech report 2.4.2) and are NOT GPU pack residents; dspark markov/confidence heads ride the MTP sidecar per MTP-sidecar law

sources.warm_path: PENDING (download in flight; do not pack until the weights gate passes)
sources.verification: Hugging Face LFS SHA-256 oids recorded per file below; warm/cold per-file equality receipt required before any pack build

shards.digest_note: all 48 LFS oids pinned in the HF tree API at revision dba1be0a; index.json weight_map maps every tensor to its shard

moe.router_bias: layers.N.ffn.gate.bias F32 [384] (bias_vl F32 [384] is the image-token correction bias twin)

ced.global_kv_source_hidden: encoder layer 19 hidden state feeds decoder Full-Mode global KV (tech report eq. 1)
ced.fact_note: per-token global KV cache 890 bytes (tech report abstract)

csa2.compress_ratios_note: entries 0-39 are backbone layers; 40-42 are the three dspark blocks (SWA-only)

indexer.indexer_k_projection: projected from main KV entries (layers.N.attn.indexer.wk BF16 [128, 512])

compressor.tensors: attn.compressor.wkv BF16 [512, 5120], wgate BF16 [512, 5120], norm BF16 [512]
compressor.semantics: CSA2 removes CSA entry overlap and absolute positional embedding; each compressed entry covers 2m original positions

kv_cache.global_kv_codec: MXFP4-class E2M1, one E4M3 scale per 16 channels, NO second-level global scale, quantized AFTER rope

hyper_connection.scheme: Single-Pass mHC (tech report 2.4.1), deployment kernel Mega-mHC
hyper_connection.coefficient_layout: A[1x4] + B[4x4] + C[4x1] = 24 coefficients; hc_attn_base F32 [24]; hc_attn_fn F32 [24, 20480] (4 streams x 5120); hc_attn_scale F32 [3]; same triple for ffn

engram.residency: host memory with background RDMA prefetch; NOT in GPU stagepack

dspark.sidecar: MTP-sidecar law: separate sysadmin sidecar files, ported LAST

precision.dense_linear_codec: FP8 E4M3 with UE8M0 scale, 32x32 weight blocks (quantization_config.weight_block_size, scale_fmt ue8m0)
precision.expert_codec: packed FP4 stored as I8 (2 nibbles/byte), UE8M0 scale per 32 input elements per output row
precision.qk_norm: q_norm BF16 [1280] on q_lora, kv_norm BF16 [512] on kv latent

tp_divisibility.open_fact_o_groups: o_groups 8 does not divide TP16; wo_a/wo_b group handling at TP16 needs a documented exemption or a 2-replica group split - decide at contract freeze

variants.base: 40 backbone layers, no dspark, global KV producer+consumer, TP-rank param
variants.dense_probe: single-layer slice for layer-0 style validation gates (SWA-only layer 0 has no CSA2 deps)
variants.dspark_sidecar: 3 dspark blocks + markov/confidence heads as separate sidecar pack; LAST per MTP-sidecar law
variants.excluded: vision tower, aligner, engram GPU residency

qualification.weights_gate: BLOCKED on warm download completion; dd-probe + hash-verify against pinned LFS oids before any pack build
qualification.next: module skeleton + stagepack contract header + packer + .experts v2 manifest producer + validator
